Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Aarti Saxena. I am a 45-year-old electrician living in Panaji. Sterling Textiles Pvt Ltd gave me a cheque for ₹35,20,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 95870 73728 or email aarti.saxena73@example.com.
